11/G.goal: Explain how VR-content and interaction factors affect cybersickness and how cybersickness can be measured and evaluated.
11/G.achieves: This gives the learner a foundation for recognizing and assessing cybersickness when developing or optimizing an XR system.

11/O1.goal: Explain how VR-content and interaction factors influence the onset and severity of cybersickness.
11/O1.achieves: It lets the learner identify design and content choices that may cause cybersickness and consider how to reduce them when building an XR system.

11/O2.goal: Explain the framework for measuring and evaluating cybersickness, including its input categories and manual or machine-learning methods.
11/O2.achieves: It lets the learner understand how to assess cybersickness with questionnaires, physiological or behavioral signals, and evaluation models during XR development and optimization.
